questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to be careful when driving in wet conditions. The road will be slippery and harder to control safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You will need to choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must stop completely. Look in all directions for traffic and pedestrians before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for the road to be clear of vehicles and pedestrians before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead. Reduce your speed to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and leave extra distance between your vehicle and others.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up. Look carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and work zones. They help you navigate safely through dangerous areas. Traffic fines may be doubled in these zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to dangerous conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending and you need to move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and give the right-of-way at an intersection. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead, so be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You will often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells you which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about upcoming hazards. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Operators can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.
